source_class: user-provided dimensioned rear-side image, physical Z measurements, and front-side photograph with physical front-glass/visible-area measurements for the final DSI506/DYL0023 display module

physical_z_measurements.status: physical scalar Z envelope measured; local XY obstruction map and FFC bend envelope remain open

front_glass_and_visible_area.status: physical envelope and visible-area size measured; individual four-edge offsets not yet measured, so centered margins are not a production bezel datum

source_dimension_notes: The image prints 116.110 mm from the upper-left outer-hole center to the right PCB edge while the overall PCB width is 121.109 mm; subtraction gives 4.999 mm. The raster is normalized to the separately indicated nominal 5.000 mm edge offset, a 0.001 mm image-label rounding discrepancy.
The 78.000 mm and 20.000 mm right-edge dimensions yield inner-hole X coordinates 43.109 mm and 101.109 mm respectively.
The 7.430 mm, 56.430 mm and 72.930 mm vertical dimensions are taken directly from the dimensioned image.
Z evidence is physical user measurement: A=7.00 mm, B=5.00 mm, C=10.00 mm using the definitions captured in dsi506_z_stack_evidence_b1.json.
Front evidence is physical user measurement: glass 120.00 x 75.00 mm and visible LCD 110 x 66 mm.
No FFC bend radius, connector-center XY, local XY position of the 10 mm maximum rear protrusion, or asymmetric visible-area edge offsets are inferred.
